$comment: Accepted npm advisories: unfixable upstream with unreachable entry points in our usage. Entry shapes: { id, package, reason } accepts one advisory id; { package, reason } (no id) accepts a whole package for findings npm reports without an advisory id (range-only dependents). Every entry must name the affected package (and GHSA id where one exists) and why it is accepted. npm audit has no --ignore flag, so scripts/ci/npm-audit-check.mjs enforces this list (CI pipes `npm audit --json` into it). Re-check entries when the dependency tree changes.
